limitations: The correction concerns the linear-filter interpretation of the printed normalization and the c=0 equilibrium spectrum. It does not invalidate the numerical continuation curves for the parameter family actually computed, nor does it provide a global nonlinear equivalence across kernel widths.
provenance: Source-specific gain/phase analysis of the shifted-Erlang ENSO feedback normalization in arXiv:2609.08127v1, with exact autonomous Hopf conditions and comparison to prior shifted-gamma stability theory.
record_title: Frequency-matched normalization for shifted-Erlang ENSO feedback
